content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. DGM Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Bharat Electronics Limited has announced a total of 06 vacancies for the Senior Deputy General Manager (E-VIA Grade) post.

rows.location: NM Delhi - 01, WFS Vishakhapatnam, Mumbai and Karwar - 01 each

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
BEL Sr. DGM Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required educational qualification, Defence Forces service experience and rank requirements mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must have a minimum of 20 years of service in Defence Forces. Eligible rank requirements include Colonel (Indian Army), Captain (Indian Navy), or Group Captain (Air Force) with 2 years seniority in the rank. The upper age limit mentioned in the notification is as on 01 September 2026.

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Any Discipline – Pass Class

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. DGM Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for ex-servicemen posts under BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026.

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. DGM Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the Senior Deputy General Manager (E-VIA Grade) post will be appointed on permanent basis with the following pay scale and benefits. Apart from basic pay, selected candidates will receive allowances and benefits as per BEL company rules, including Dearness Allowance, HRA, 35% of basic pay as perks, PF, Gratuity, Pension, Group Insurance, Performance Related Pay and Medical Reimbursement for self and dependent family members.

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. DGM Job Description
content_sections.text: The Senior Deputy General Manager role involves technical coordination, business development activities and liaison between BEL Strategic Business Units (SBUs) and various Defence organisations. Coordinate with Army HQ / Navy HQ / Air HQ, Ministry of Defence, DGQA, DRDO, certification agencies and other PSUs for business requirements. Participate in product demonstrations, presentations, exhibitions and seminars for promoting BEL products. Maintain professional networks with customers and related stakeholders for business development. Provide knowledge and experience related to products and systems supplied to Defence Forces. Support market intelligence activities and customer support requirements. Handle other responsibilities assigned by management.

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. DGM Selection Process
content_sections.text: The BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026 selection process includes shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Final selection result will be published on the BEL website.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official BEL recruitment website. Read all instructions mentioned in the notification. Complete the online application form with correct details. Upload required documents. Verify all details before final submission. Submit the application before 06 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: BEL Sr. DGM Apply Online Details
Documents Required for BEL Sr. DGM Application
content_sections.text: Candidates need to upload the required documents while submitting the online application. Recent passport size colour photograph. Date of Birth proof document. B.E./B.Tech final degree certificate with mark sheets. Proof of Defence Forces service, rank seniority and NOC (for serving officers). Discharge Book and related documents (for retired Defence officers). OBC certificate, if applicable. Identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, Driving License, Voter ID or Passport.

faq.question: Q1. What is BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment notification released by Bharat Electronics Limited for Senior Deputy General Manager (E-VIA Grade) posts on permanent basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 06 Senior Deputy General Manager vacancies are available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have B.E./B.Tech in any discipline with Pass Class qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Serving and retired Defence Forces officers meeting the required qualification, experience and rank criteria can apply.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for BEL Sr. DGM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 52 years for General category and 55 years for OBC category.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of BEL Senior Deputy General Manager?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a pay scale of ₹90,000 - 3% - ₹2,40,000 along with admissible allowances and benefits.
